quandoUsar: A row of icons where only the control in use shows its name, like Share, Save, and Notify on an article.
Filters or states in chip form (`variant="chip"`) that, when active, show the value and a clear action, like “Status: Open ×”.
quandoEvitar: Use `expanding-button-group` when the icons form a single bar and the label should follow the pointer or focus, with no click.
Use `chip-group` when the person chooses among several filter options.
Use `button` with a label when the action is used often: here the name only appears after a click.

teclado.acao: On the main button, open or close the control; on the extra action, run `action.onClick`.
With the control open, closes it and returns focus to the main button.

acessibilidade: The main button has `aria-expanded` and an `aria-label` equal to `label`, open or closed; the visible label and `detail` are `aria-hidden`, so anything that is only in `detail` is not announced.
The extra action is a second `<button>` with `aria-label` and `title` from `action.label`; it only exists with the control open and comes right after the main one in the `Tab` order.
movimento: On open, the width grows on a spring with no overshoot and the label slides 8 px out of a slight blur; on close, it fades quickly while the width shrinks, and neighbors follow with no jump.
The icon stays still in a box the size of the closed control and shrinks to 0.86 on press; the extra action shrinks to 0.9.
With “reduce motion”, the label and the action only fade, the width changes at once, and the press does not change the scale.
notasIA: To keep only one open at a time, control it in the parent: `expanded={aberto === "share"}` and `onExpandedChange={v => setAberto(v ? "share" : null)}`.
`action` takes `icon`, `label`, and `onClick` and only appears with the control open; `detail` adds text after the label, like a count.
`tone="accent"` fills with the accent color when open, and `variant="chip"` is the compact version, 2rem tall, for filters and tags.
